source_snapshot.note: All six proposed keys are absent from the 418-key snapshot. All 92 refutation keys occur there with REFUTED status and identical statement text; three registry scope notes are longer than their refutation-ledger counterparts. Semantic distinctions below are scoped judgments, not an absence-of-all-future-alias proof.

shared_definitions.tree: finite ordinary connected acyclic simple graph
shared_definitions.rank: natural p with x(T)+2<=p and strict 3p<2alpha(T)+1; k=p-1
shared_definitions.selector: F={every original degree-one leaf v: Delta_p(T-v)<0}; each leaf is a distinct tag, including shared supports
shared_definitions.marked_counts: H_v=T-{v,s_v}; W_v=N_T(s_v) minus {v}; q_v(j)=number of independent j-sets in H_v meeting W_v; Q=sum_F q_v(k); U=sum_F q_v(k+1); E=sum over selected marked k-sets of actual addable vertices; C=sum over selected tags of the number of multiply marked upper sets, once per upper set per tag
shared_definitions.exact_relation: E=kU+C and S=U-Q, hence S<=0 iff E-C<=kQ

reviews.exact_scope: Every eligible ordinary (T,p) under the shared strict selector, with i_x(T)>0: i_x(T) E <= (x+1)i_(x+1)(T) Q, equivalently E<=mu_x Q where mu_x=(x+1)i_(x+1)/i_x.
relations: This universal premise implies the flat budget and therefore the primary S<=0 because mu_x<x+1<=k.
C3-U5-EARLY-DESCENT-MARKED-OCCUPANCY-BRIDGE proves only the implication from this premise to S<=0; the premise itself is unproved.
For Q>0 it is equivalent to Cov_p(w_F,e)/E_p[w_F] <= mu_x-mu_p, with Q=0 handled separately.
reviews.not_same_claim: The registered lower-region aggregate states only E-C<=kQ. The refuted E993-C3-G1-POINTWISE-ADDABILITY-BOUND is per independent residual set in a different G1 scope; this is one selected tagged total. The eligible order-14 positive covariance refutes the shortcut E/Q<=mu_p, not this quantitative comparison.
reviews.limitations: No universal tilt bound; 2230 diagnostic rows all had the full leaf selector, so proper-selector coverage is missing.

reviews.exact_scope: Every eligible ordinary (T,p) under the shared strict selector: E<=(x+1)Q.
relations: CT_x implies this because first strict descent gives mu_x<x+1.
This implies the current-rank budget because x+1<=k.
It implies S<=0 through E=kU+C and C>=0.
reviews.not_same_claim: It drops the exact coefficient ratio from CT_x and does not follow from the registered conditional CT_x implication. It is stronger than the primary scalar target whenever C can compensate; failure alone does not refute S. It is a total selected-tag budget, not the terminal per-set G1 bound.
reviews.limitations: The numerical threshold equals the current-rank threshold at p=x+2; no universal proof or separating eligible witness was supplied.

reviews.exact_scope: Every eligible ordinary (T,p) under the shared strict selector: E<=kQ, k=p-1.
relations: This implies S<=0 because E-C<=E; conversely S<=0 only gives E-C<=kQ.
At p=x+2 its threshold coincides with the flat threshold.
reviews.not_same_claim: The registered primary assertion allows a positive multiply marked correction C; this proposal discards it. The marked incidence identity and bipartite shadow bound give E=kU+C and a different upper bound depending on alpha; neither is this universal selected-tree budget. The refuted pointwise addability claim has different quantifiers and guard.
reviews.limitations: A failure is a mechanism failure unless E-C>kQ is also shown.

reviews.exact_scope: Every ordinary tree T and natural p>=3 with |V(T)|=2p+3 and x(T)+2<=p; every original leaf v has Delta_(p-1)(T-{v,s_v})-Delta_(p-1)(T-N_T[s_v])<=0, without alpha or favorable-selector hypotheses.
relations: Implies the selected aggregate on precisely this order shell whenever the lower-region guard also holds.
Extends the order n<=2p+1 pointwise band and the n=2p+2 first-shell pointwise result to a different exact order; neither registered theorem itself covers n=2p+3.
reviews.not_same_claim: The pointwise universal assertion at exact parent order 2p+3 is stronger than the restricted aggregate there and is disjoint in order from the registered first-shell key. The 92 refutations include broad pointwise and bare matching failures, but no witness at this exact early-descent tree scope; edge-addition monotonicity must not be imported.
reviews.limitations: The preparation report gives an informal proof with finite injection evidence and a registered forest linear-bound dependency for p=3..5; raw injection rows and Lean receipt were not listed for this intake. No proof award proposed.

reviews.exact_scope: Every ordinary tree T and natural p>=14 with |V(T)|=2p+4 and x(T)+2<=p; every original leaf v has Delta_(p-1)(T-{v,s_v})-Delta_(p-1)(T-N_T[s_v])<=0, without alpha or favorable-selector hypotheses.
relations: Implies the lower-region selected aggregate only on this exact shell and p>=14.
The p10..13 cells and larger order excess are outside its scope.
reviews.not_same_claim: Its order and rank differ from the first and second-shell keys. The eligible n24,p10 six-cover tree refutes only the attempted tau>=7 proof step, with all pointwise terms negative; it does not refute this p>=14 assertion or establish its low-rank extension. Bare matching refutations at smaller matchings do not cover the five/four-edge residual hypotheses here.
reviews.limitations: Informal proof relies on a pinned first-wide theorem and finite matching certificates not listed in this intake; the universal SCD lift and graph reductions were read in the report, not formally checked here.

reviews.exact_scope: For every integer m>=1, T_m is path 0-1-2 with m center-at-0 three-private-leaf claws; for every p satisfying x(T_m)+2<=p and strict 3p<2alpha(T_m)+1, the complete original strict-selector S(T_m,p)<=0, with arm and claw leaf orbits tested separately.
relations: It is a family restriction of the registered all-ordinary-tree lower-region aggregate.

The r19 four-ratio package is a proposed sufficient analytic package on its own exact coefficient ranges; the draft does not assert those four inequalities, and no ordinary/governed semantic bridge is supplied by its registry text.
The C3 finite m<=50 rows and T67 row are bounded evidence only; the C3 all-leaf Q polynomial applies only if both orbits are selected.
reviews.not_same_claim: All eligible m and ranks with the actual two-orbit selector is neither the four-ratio r19 package nor a finite family census. The exact conditional polynomial identity in C3 is algebra, not a sign theorem.
reviews.limitations: No all-m selector classification or uniform coefficient sign proof; the four r19 ratios and their ordinary-tree interpretation were not included as formulas in this brief.

terminal_status_rule: No VERIFIED or REFUTED registered key is reopened; registration and dispatch are controller decisions.
